subject: general
question: Delhi Sultanate was established in which of the following years?
solution:
The correct answer is __**1206.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The **Delhi Sultanate, **which had Delhi as its **capital, controlled over a vast area of South Asia **for 320 years (1206–1526). 
 
• About three centuries later,** Qutb-ud-din Aibak,** who created the Delhi Sultanate in **1206 under the Mamluk dynasty,** would establish Muslim dominance in** Northern India.**
 
• The beginning of the** Delhi sultanate marks the end** of the authority of several** Muslim dynasties in India **( 1210-1526). Between 1175 and 1206, **Muhamed bin Sams' and his lieutenant Qutub-ud-din Aibak's **campaigns served as the catalyst. The triumph over the **Rajput monarchs **was what laid the groundwork for the **Delhi sultanate.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• The **Delhi Sultanate** was first ruled by **Qutubuddin Aibak. About 200 years** passed during the Sultanate. **Ibrahim Lodi** served as the final Sultan.
 
• The first monarch of Delhi,** Anangapala of the Tomara Dynasty, **built the city as its capital. One of the early mediaeval empires in northern India was the **Tomara Dynasty.**
 
• The** Delhi Sultanate **came to an end in **1526 when Babur established the Mughal Empire** by defeating** Ibrahim Lodi**, the last Lodi sultan, and his soldiers at the** first Battle of Panipat. **
